purpose: Inspect public stronger ARC solvers without importing evaluation answers into runtime.

varc.pretraining_description: Paper describes ARC-1 training and ReARC; this alone does not prove ARC-2 non-exposure.
blockers: The published experiment script enumerates task IDs and assumes multiple GPUs.
Its prediction flow invokes analysis that reads public evaluation answers; the loader can use test output shape when such output is present.
When test output is absent the loader constructs an input-copy placeholder; impact on selection must be tested.
Checkpoint provenance, exact file download/hash, dependency permissions, Kaggle offline packaging and the account GPU quota are not yet established.
varc.safe_next_step: Separate prediction from analysis; pass only train and test input, discard task-specific routing, test that absence or changes of withheld outputs cannot affect predictions, then benchmark with matching budgets and posthoc scoring.

nvarc.observation: The published fine-tuning configuration names arc2_evaluation6 and dataset generation can include evaluation test outputs in training pairs. The training provenance of any particular weight must be proven before use.

limitations: Source pages and repository branches may change; no external repository commit or model bytes were downloaded or validated here.
No performance or official Kaggle score is claimed.
